text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered for KV cache OOM on hosted-runtime-03. Alerts show rapid KV growth from long prompt sessions. Escalating to on-call SRE.
Alex: Seeing oom spikes + GPU OOMs on 03 and 04. KVMAP size jumps from 1.2GB to 12GB in ~30s for a few sessions.
Priya: Noticing a handful of clients with extremely long prompts (20k+ tokens) hitting the hosted endpoint. Looks like prefetch plus continuous batching kept appending.
Maria: Which model/route? Any service names?
Alex: route=/api/v1/generate model=rw-3b-compat, batcher=continuous_batcher.py, prefetch=true
Devon: I can take runtime handoff. Priya, can you collect sample request ids?
Priya: Pushed a filter: `request_id` list -> 78b3... 9f2a... Captured raw prompt for one, it's a concatenation of many chat turns.
CS-Eli: Customer ShopMate reported slow responses ~5m ago and then errors; they have a high-volume session. Confirming impact.
Ryan: Initial mitigation idea: disable prefetch on hosted pool, and set a soft session cap to prevent infinite prefix growth.
Alex: Agreed. Quick hotpatch: set `kv_prefetch.enabled=false` on hosted-runtime-03 and 04, and `continuous_batcher.max_batch_tokens=1024` to limit growth.
Devon: Applying hotpatch to 03 now. Command: ```
# on runtime-ctrl
curl -X POST https://runtime-control/api/v1/hotpatch -d '{"kv_prefetch.enabled":false,"continuous_batcher.max_batch_tokens":1024}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Hotpatch started on hosted-runtime-03 (deploy id dpl_2026_03_15_01).
Maria: Rolling to 04 in 30s after we verify 03. Watch eviction metrics.
Priya: While patching, I'm throttling the ShopMate route at edge with `rate_limit=60r/m` to reduce simultaneous long sessions.
Alex: Verified: after hotpatch on 03, kvmap growth stopped for the offending sessions. GPU memory stabilized.
CS-Eli: ShopMate reports degraded UX but no 500s now. They appreciate the fast update.
Devon: Secondary mitigation: enable fallback routing to smaller model variant `rw-3b-lite` for sessions >10k tokens. I'll apply a routing rule in traffic-mgr.
Alex: Add an automatic session cap of 15k tokens and aggressive eviction policy for KV: `evict_policy=tail_prefetch,evict_threshold_bytes=3GB`.
Priya: Patch for traffic-mgr: ```
PUT /routes/ShopMate
{
  "session_token_limit": 15000,
  "route_overrides": [{"condition":"session_tokens>10000","model":"rw-3b-lite"}]
}
```
Ryan: Monitoring continuous_batcher queue latency. If batching backlog > 200ms, we should force immediate flush to avoid more accumulation.
Alex: Heads-up for on-call: this is still P1 while we confirm no other hosts affected. Handing off to SRE rotation next shift. @Devon you're primary for the next hour.
Devon: Acknowledged. I'll keep this thread and open a bridge if we see reoccurrence.
Maria: Quick postmortem notes: root cause seems combination of (1) unbounded prefetch + (2) continuous batching holding on to partial KV entries for very long sessions. Long prompts keep appending prefixes, which weren't protected by session caps.
Priya: Action items: 1) backfill unit test for continuous_batcher to simulate long prompt appends, 2) add server-side session caps + metric, 3) default `kv_prefetch.enabled=false` for hosted until we add tenant-safe limits.
CS-Eli: I'll file a customer incident update for ShopMate: timeline, mitigation, and follow-up plan.
ops-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-0315-KV-01.
Alex: Also schedule a rollback window if we see downstream perf cliffs from `rw-3b-lite` fallback.
Devon: I'll own a hotfix PR to make prefetch opt-in per-tenant with sane defaults. Planning to land tomorrow morning.
Priya: For follow-up: add an alert for `kvmap.growth_rate > 50MB/s per-host` and `prefetch.active_sessions > 10`.
Ryan: Confirming metrics baseline updated and dashboards annotated.
Alex: Thanks all. Leaving the thread open for on-call handoff. If anything spikes, ping SRE rotation. :thumbsup:
